report_identity.report_title: Tongda Group Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures consumer electronics structural components and household and sports goods, with most assets and cash located in PRC/Hong Kong manufacturing subsidiaries.

segments.business_substance: Manufacturing of handset casing components, high-precision components, smart appliance panels, network communication facilities and other electrical consumer products.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025 note 4 segment revenue, p.88

segments.business_substance: Manufacturing of durable household goods, household utensils and sports goods.
segments.source: Annual Report 2025 note 4 segment revenue, p.88

business_overview.revenue_model: Sale of goods; performance obligation is satisfied on delivery and payment is generally due within one to three months, except new customers usually pay in advance.
business_notes: The high precision micro components business was disposed in April 2024, reducing comparability of 2024 and 2025.
Largest customer and five largest customers represented 25.0% and 37.2% of trade and bills receivables at 31 December 2025.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Other income, not ordinary manufacturing margin.

non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 note 7 and note 18, p.92 and p.114

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank balances and cash; RMB-denominated cash and equivalents were HK$673,308 thousand and RMB is not freely convertible.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 20, p.52 and p.118

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank time deposits, including HK$92,834 thousand non-current deposits maturing after twelve months.
Deposits pledged to banks to secure short-term banking facilities.

funds_assets.item: Structured deposits and wealth management products at FVTPL
funds_assets.business_substance: PRC bank structured deposits and short-term wealth management products measured at FVTPL; bank guaranteed principal, returns linked to exchange rates or market indices.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 note 21 and note 32, p.118 and p.142

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from sale of manufactured goods, generally one to three months credit terms, with some longer terms for established customers.
Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods; provision against inventories was HK$311,649 thousand.
Factories and production equipment for manufacturing operations.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, p.52

investment_assets.business_substance: Investment properties in Shenzhen and Xiamen, Level 3 valuation.

other_assets.business_substance: Deposits for acquisitions of property, plant and equipment.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current and non-current secured/unsecured bank and other loans.
Operating leases for continuing business premises and assets.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables, normally settled on 60 to 90 days.
Operating accruals and payables, including contract liabilities.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position and note 5, p.52 and p.90

other_liabilities.item: Tax payable and deferred tax liabilities
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025 statement of financial position, p.52-53

years.source: Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, p.55-56
Annual Report 2025 cash flow statement, p.55-56
Annual Report 2024 cash flow statement and MD&A, local 2024 annual report text

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow exceeded reported parent profit, but after PPE purchases free cash flow was slightly negative. 2023 and 2024 are distorted by losses, impairments and disposal of a business. The distributable cash profit denominator should be materially discounted.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 note 34 capital management table, p.152
evidence.note: Cash, pledged deposits, structured deposits/wealth management products and time deposits.
Bank and other borrowings repayable within one year and in the second/third year.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company versus each subsidiary; RMB cash location and dividend/remittance path must be haircut conservatively.
The annual report discloses FVTPL products in aggregate and does not list each product's exact bank, term and redemption restrictions.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not precisely disclosed; the owner-earnback denominator uses a conservative estimate rather than a company-provided maintenance capex number.
